### Summary

The Python package reports its version from the installed package metadata, and falls back to `0.0.0` when no
metadata is found ({{< code python/__init__.py >}}). How the build derives the version from git is a stub in this
draft.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Report the installed kintera version as `kintera.__version__`.

**Data.** pending

**Placement.** On import.

**Activation.** Always.

**Guarantee / limits.** pending

**Evidence.** pending
:::

### Derivation

No derivation: this scheme reads metadata.

### Numerical method

No numerical method and no figure: this scheme reads metadata.
